1.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
1.comment: Inspector observed no staff present during the inspection to have a valid certified food protection manager (CFPM) certificate. The only staff member present was within his first 30 days of hire and lacked any required certification. Ensure at least one CFPM is present at all times of food preparation and service.

2.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
2.comment: Employees were observed not using gloves properly and not performing handwashing before donning gloves. Education was provided. The PIC instructed employees to wash their hands and put on gloves properly while inspector was present. Ensure that employees are knowledgeable of the appropriate handwashing and gloves usage procedures at all times.

3.title: Food separated and protected.
3.comment: Inspector observed an unsealed package of hot dogs to be stored in direct contact with a personal take-out bag of fast food. The PIC was informed that this storage method is hazardous due cross contamination. The hot dogs were sealed and moved to a safe position in the cooler during today’s visit. Ensure personal items are stored below food for the consumer or in a non-permeable container to prevent cross-contamination.

4.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
4.comment: Insepctor observed no stem thermometer available at the facility for measuring the temperature of time/temperature control for safety foods. The staff member present was informed, and he stated that the thermometer has been ordered. The inspector will follow-up on December 4, 2026 to ensure a stem thermometer is available.

5.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
5.comment: Inspector observed no sanitizer available at the start of today’s inspection. The staff member present was educated regarding sanitizer requirements and a quaternary ammonia sanitizer bucket was prepared, measuring 150ppm. Ensure a sanitizer bucket is prepared prior to starting any food preparation or service.
